6.0
6.1 Policy review cadence
6.1.1 This policy shall be reviewed annually.
6.1.2 This policy shall also be reviewed upon significant changes to Inmar’s business,
regulatory, and/or technical environment that could impact the content of this
document.
6.2 Compliance measurement
6.2.1 The Information Security Governance, Risk, and Compliance team will verify
compliance to this policy through various methods, including but not limited to,
business tool reports, internal and external audits, and feedback to the author.
6.3 Sanctions
6.3.1 Inmar’s sanction policy applies appropriate sanctions, up to and including
termination, against Inmar team members who fail to comply with Inmar’s
Information Security Policies and Procedures. Sanctions occur with appropriate
involvement of Inmar’s human resources and legal departments.

6.3.2 Inmar team members must comply with all applicable Information Security Policies
and Procedures in order to ensure the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of
data in its information systems.
6.3.3 Inmar provides annual security awareness training to team members on their
Information Security Policies and Procedures.
6.3.4 Inmar prefers that team members self-report any inadvertent violations of Inmar’s
Policies and Procedures. A self-report will result in counseling by the Privacy
Officer or its legal parent’s human resources or legal department. Repeated
inadvertent violations may result in disciplinary action up to and including
termination.
Exceptions
7.0
7.1 Any exception to the policy must be approved by the Chief Information Security Officer
(CISO) or designee in advance.
